places.normalized: Plashwater Weir Mill Lock (fictional lock on the Thames)
places.quote: Plashwater Weir Mill Lock looked tranquil and pretty on an evening in the summer time.
places.note: Fictional lock; location on the upper Thames is not specified in the passage.

places.quote: say Richmond—and this, if you had a mind to it.
places.note: Richmond was outside the County of London in Dickens's day, though now a London borough; the passage's own sense is upriver.
